Missing prepare_refresh_token_request method in OAuth2 Client

#### Description

The `prepare_refresh_token_request` method has been removed from the OAuth2 Client class, breaking existing functionality for refresh token requests.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.oauth2 import Client

client = Client('my_client_id')
url = 'https://example.com/token'
token = 'my_refresh_token'

# This should work but raises AttributeError
u, h, b = client.prepare_refresh_token_request(url, token)
```

Expected: Method should prepare a proper refresh token request with URL, headers, and body.
Actual: `AttributeError: 'Client' object has no attribute 'prepare_refresh_token_request'`

The method was previously available and used to prepare refresh token requests according to RFC 6749 specifications.
</issue>
